prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: exploration draft for the PinHaoYun private photo and cloud-storage iPhone app, NOT a finished app-icon tile.
Primary request: redesign a distinctive simple cloud + ONE jigsaw-piece logo, in blue and cyan. Friendly, clever and dependable. Flat vector-like geometric artwork with smooth deliberate curves and a compact, optically balanced silhouette. The concept must survive reduction to 32px.
Composition: exactly ONE centered symbol, around 65–70% of the square canvas, generous consistent clear space.
Color palette: vivid medium blue #2874ED and fresh cyan #18BED1 only, optionally a restrained smooth transition between those colors.
Background: truly transparent alpha; negative spaces must also be transparent, not painted white.
Constraints: no words, letters, captions, typography, faces, stars, shields, locks, cameras, busy details, multi-piece grids, app-icon rounded-square backgrounds, shadows, mockups, 3D, bevels or watermark. Do not reproduce OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Photos.
Specific concept A1, integrated contour: one bold rounded continuous cloud outline, in blue/cyan. Integrate exactly one clearly recognizable jigsaw tab/socket into the lower contour itself. The jigsaw feature is part of the cloud shape, not a second emblem inside it. Use a thick confident stroke and spacious transparent interior. Contemporary simple geometry, very few curves, slightly personable proportions.
